Short cards about the scams that hurt Indians the most.
What real police / banks never do
A caller claims to be CBI, police or customs and says a parcel or case is in your name. They keep you on a video call and demand money to “clear” it.
Real police never arrest, interrogate or fine you over a phone or video call. There is no such thing as a “digital arrest”.
An SMS says your KYC is expiring or your account will be blocked, and gives a link to “update” it.
Banks never ask you to update KYC through a link in a message. Do it only in the bank’s own app or branch.
A “job” offers easy money but asks for a registration, security or training fee first.
A real employer never asks you to pay to get a job.
You “won” a lottery or lucky draw you never entered, and must pay a tax or fee to claim it.
You cannot win a lottery you never entered. Nobody gives free money for a small fee.
An instant loan app gives money fast, then threatens to call your contacts or leak morphed photos if you do not pay up.
No legal lender threatens your family or your photos. Report such apps and do not pay.
An unknown number video-calls you, records it, and then threatens to share it unless you pay.
Do not pay and do not panic, paying never stops them. Save the evidence and report to police or cybercrime.gov.in.
Do these steps in order. Acting in the first few hours matters the most.
Call the national cyber-crime helpline 1930 as soon as you can. Early reports have the best chance of freezing the money.
Call your bank on the official number on your card or passbook and ask them to freeze the account or stop the transaction.
File a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in. Keep the acknowledgement number.
Save screenshots, the numbers involved, the time and the amount. Do not delete anything.
Add trusted contacts. When a check is Dangerous you can alert them with one tap, always by you, never automatically.
⚠️ Suraksha Saathi: I got a suspicious message that looks like a scam. I have not sent any money. Please call me.
Paste an SMS, WhatsApp message or link and get a clear verdict with reasons, Safe, Be Careful or Dangerous.
All checking happens on your phone. No login, no ads, no tracking. Nothing is uploaded.
Hindi and English, big buttons, Easy Mode for elders, a Kids Safe Mode, and voice in and out.
Every check shows a confidence level and plain reasons. We never claim 100% accuracy.

What stays on your phone:

• Messages you check and the verdicts
• Your history and saved evidence
• Your blocklist and family contacts
• All settings

These are stored only in this app on this phone. We do not have servers, and we never upload your SMS, contacts or call data.

What can leave the phone, only if YOU allow it:

• Notification text is read on the device for auto-check, it is not sent anywhere
• If you switch on Online mode and tap “Send it”, only that one message text goes to the server you configured, for a better explanation

Permissions we ask for, and why:

• Notifications, to show a warning
• Microphone, only when you tap Speak
• Notification access, optional, for auto-check
• Contacts, optional, to skip known callers in call reminders
• Internet, only for the optional Online mode; the app is fully offline without it
